name: Damion Shard: Ace Attorney
source:
In the year 2016, the near future, the once great nation, United States of America, is a shadow of its former self. Legislation has been passed which has greatly restricted the rights of those accused of crimes, removing privileges such as trial by jury. The individual's rights are eschewed in favor of businesses and corporations. Lobbyists from large companies, such as Shard Corporation, contaminate the legal system with restrictive laws designed to keep the less affluent from filing lawsuits against large companies.

The CEO of Shard Corporation, Lord Shard, is also a renowned prosecutor, as has been his family's tradition for generations. But after a mysterious incident atop the Shard Corporation building, a cloud of secrets hanging over the past of the Shard family was revealed. Lord Shard's son, Damion, was forever changed by that incident. Soon, Damion decided to become a defense attorney, a decision that astonished his family. However, Lord Shard decided to create a small law firm so that his son could practice as a defense attorney. But with each case he takes, Damion discovers that there is quite a lot that he doesn't know about the Shard family, and eventually uncovers a dark secret about his own past... (http://www.ksatechnologyhq.com:1357/mainsite/games/pwlib/damion)
translation:
时间来到近未来的2016年。曾经强盛的美利坚合众国，如今只剩昔日荣光的残影。新法案大幅限制刑事被告人的权利，取消陪审团审判等保障。个人权利遭到牺牲，企业与公司则备受偏袒。Shard公司等大企业的说客用限制性法律污染司法制度，阻止穷人起诉大公司。

Shard公司的首席执行官Shard勋爵也是一位著名检察官，这份职业在他的家族中代代相传。然而，Shard公司大楼顶层发生一桩神秘事件后，笼罩Shard家族往昔的重重秘密逐渐浮出水面。Shard勋爵之子Damion的一生也被那场事件永久改变。不久，Damion决定成为辩护律师，令家人大为震惊。Shard勋爵却决定成立一家小型律师事务所，让儿子得以从事辩护工作。可随着接手的案件越来越多，Damion逐渐发现，自己对Shard家族还有太多不了解的事情，并最终揭开了关于自身过去的黑暗秘密……（http://www.ksatechnologyhq.com:1357/mainsite/games/pwlib/damion）
